messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: When cholesterol and fats build up along your artery walls, in a process called atherosclerosis, they narrow the blood vessels and reduce blood and oxygen flow to your heart, brain, and other parts of your body. By slowing cholesterol production, atorvastatin helps prevent this buildup to keep blood flowing more freely to vital organs.
Lowering your blood level of cholesterol and fats with atorvastatin may help prevent heart disease, angina (chest pain), strokes, and heart attacks.
Your healthcare provider will check your blood lipid levels regularly to assess how well your treatment is working. These measurements include:
- LDL-C: Low-density lipoprotein (“bad” cholesterol)
- HDL-C: High-density lipoprotein (“good” cholesterol)
- TG: Triglycerides (a type of blood fat)
- Total-C: Total cholesterol

The relation 'reduces' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug decreases the amount or level of the substance or buildup specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
D. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
